sources.title: Local Japanese classic catalog: Split Earth
TCGdex Japanese set endpoint: E4 / Split Earth

claims.text: The local Japanese classic catalog models Split Earth / 裂けた大地 with an August 23, 2002 release date.
The local catalog and TCGdex-derived metadata model 91 total rows for Split Earth, while the same metadata records 88 official rows.
Split Earth is modeled as a Japanese main expansion in the ポケモンカードe series, using TCGdex set id E4.

Split Earth matters because the e-Card frame turns rupture into collection grammar: underground movement, fossil return, duplicate-name Eevee rows, and a mythic late-number Ho-Oh all make the set feel physically split.

The local deepening queue highlights Umbreon 071, Umbreon 072, Ho-Oh 091, Ledian 007, Crobat 009, and Flareon 017; this tranche also hand-authors Raikou, Alakazam, Aerodactyl, Underground Expedition, Crystal Shard, Golem, and Kabutops because they teach duplicate-name, terrain, artifact, and map-edge identity.

The local Japanese classic rows for this release do not provide illustrator authority, so this tranche leaves artist coverage unresolved rather than inventing or importing credits without a cited source.

Agents should preserve Japanese title 裂けた大地, TCGdex set id E4, card number, local id, rough source-row text, normalized collector label, duplicate-name row context, and the 88 official / 91 total row distinction before treating a famous species or English Aquapolis match as this exact release row.
